full_name: Andrew Baker | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
title: 2023–2024 Physical Sciences William Bentinck-Smith Fellow Rutgers University–New Brunswick
bio: Andrew Baker is a professor at Rutgers, The State University of New Jersey, and an extraordinary professor at the University of the Western Cape whose research uses radio, millimeter, and submillimeter wavelength observations to probe both nearby and distant galaxies.
